ns2:course.label: Applied Nonlinear Programming
ns2:course.description: (I E 401) Optimization of nonlinear systems, including a survey of classical methods and concepts such as the Lagrangian method, the Jacobian method, and Kuhn-Tucker conditions; emphasizes modern algorithms, numerical methods for digital computers, applications in engineering design, and use of state-of-the-art computer codes. Prerequisite: IE 310 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
